frequency_resolution.reference: 0.05 rad/s everywhere + 0.025 rad/s inside gap-resonance bands

natural_frequencies_illustrative.note: Undamped roots on the computed band (added mass evaluated at the root). Several roots per DOF can occur because potential-flow added mass varies sharply near the resonances of the water trapped between the float rows (and between the boat hull and the floats); those bands are listed. Real viscous damping, absent from the BEM, limits them.

heading_interpolation.note: informational: the app uses exact headings; interpolation is a fallback only

boat.name: Hydronaute (Renaud 8000) - reference reconstruction v1
boat.mass_note: archival_light_weight_unverified (2.1 t on the archived sheet; Fluvial page says 3.0 t; current restored boat not weighed); alternatives [2100, 3000] kg. Not the measured current boat.
boat.hull_note: closed gull-wing envelope rebuilt from the package station table (same loft as its build_model.py); NOT a measured hull - no offsets exist. At the package's drawn waterline (z=0) it displaces ~4.9 m3, far more than the 2.1-3.0 t references: the proxy hull form and/or its waterline datum are not consistent.

placement.source: modelling_assumption: boat stern 0.1 m forward of the EXO rear deck plate edge (x = 2.2 m), centred between the float rows; stern/aft cabin under the frame bays, bow 5.15 m beyond the end frame. Vertical position and attitude come from the boat's own flotation, never from this transform.

proxy_hull_at_drawn_waterline.note: mass the proxy hull would need to float at the package's z=0 waterline; compare with the 2.1-3.0 t references -> hull form/datum consistency check

equilibrium.sign_convention: boat frame: heel right-handed about +X (stern->bow), + = port side up; trim right-handed about +Y (port), + = bow down
equilibrium.draft_note: hull proxy only (keel excluded, +~0.22 m); catalogue draft 0.75 m incl. keel

stability_static.note: GM from the analytic restoring matrix (waterplane integrals) about the COM at the solved attitude (about world X / Y axes).

lateral_clearance_to_float_inner_face_m.note: boat topsides at the station half-beam vs the float proxy inner face, over the overlapping x-range
